title: Rated Exceeds in my first year in software excellence
summary: My 2019 review was rated Exceeds for the speed with which I built a network across the company and scaled up to many workshops with good feedback.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: a review, not an intervention.
what_i_did: Ran 29 workshops (average effectiveness 8.93/10), met 235 people across about 100 teams and 52 roles, mentored two groups of new joiners and supported the duplicate-code removal.
what_changed: My manager rated the year Exceeds.

quotes.text: Exceeds is related to the speed with which Datta built a network, ramped up to many workshops and preparations and got good feedback.
